No. 1988/6 – MONDAY OCTOBER, 10, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460), as amended by the Land Acquisition Act (amendment)
Land Acquisition For The University of Uva Wellassa

Notice Under Section 7 My No. : BD/BD/LND/3/5/5. Ministry of Land Development Ref. No.: 4/3/13/2013/E/72. I hereby give notice to the public under Sub - section (1) of Section (7) of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by Land Acquisition Act (amendment) No. 28 of 1964, the land described below is required by the government and the Government intends to acquire the said land/servitude for a public purpose.

Description of the land/ servitude to be Acquired :- The schedule No.01 including the blocks of land and boundaries stated below called Hingurugamuwawatte, 6.2783 Hectares in extent indicated in the preliminary plan bearing F.V.P.37 and additional 49 dated 23-08-2016, prepared by the Survey General, Situated in Rambukpotha village of 80 H GlenAlphin Grama Niladhari Division of Rilpola Korale, coming under Badulla Divisional Secretary Division of Badulla District of Uva Province. The Schedule No.02 including the following boundaries and details of the block of land called Hinguru-

gamuwawatte, 3.8172 Hectares in extent indicated in the preliminary plan bearing F.V.P.80 and additional 56 dated 23-08-2016, prepared by the Survey General, Situated in Hanwella village of 80 H GlenAlphin Grama Niladhari Division of Rilpola Korale, coming under Badulla Divisional Secretary Division of Badulla District of Uva Province.

North: Lot No. 33 and F.V.P. 37 (Rambankpotha Village); East: Block No. 33 and F.V.P. 37 (Rombunkpotha Village) and Lot No. 686; South: Lot No. 686 and 33; West: Lot No. 33.

All those who claim ownership, interest and any other connection to aforesaid land, should appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Badulla on the 09th of November 2016 at 2.30 p. m.

In addition, hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies of the nature of their interests in the land/ lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount before 26th of October, 2016.
P.S.P. ABEYWARDHANA, Divisional Secretariaty, Badulla.
